influences.name: Joe Losey
influences.context: The American director Joe Losey once said, "Beware of a cozy British film set, because often, in the creative process, 'niceness' can lead to disaster."

influences.name: Abel Gance
influences.context: I borrowed from Abel Gance and suspended the camera on a pendulum to film Geldof thrashing around in the imagined pool of blood as Pink recalls his father's death.

influences.name: Stanley Kubrick
influences.context: Many years later Stanley Kubrick shot much of Full Metal Jacket there, but in 1981 the industrial waste was still in evidence

influences.name: Roger Waters
influences.context: I'm heavily inspired by Roger Waters' basslines, and they are the reason I picked up bass

influences.name: George Orwell
influences.context: Waters also took a more dominant role at the mic, as he dove into a savage theme straight out of George Orwell's Animal Farm.
